verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a commerce and payments platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no first-party bulk data export, open-format download, or account-exit capability. API and toolkit access to orders and transaction details are developer building blocks that could approximate an export, not an export feature itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
